name: STAR Frames — state between an inertial and a rotating frame
summary: Position and velocity between an inertial frame and a frame rotating about z at a given angle and rate, transport term included, in both directions; on 600 states there and back the results agree with NAIF SPICE (rav2xf), SciPy and astropy within 5.2e-16 of |r| and of |v| + |rate| |r|.
reference: WGS-84 angular velocity of the Earth 7292115.0e-11 rad/s (NIMA TR8350.2); by hand: a point fixed on the equator (radius 6378.137 km) is at rest in the rotating frame

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: angle in radians about +z, rate in rad/s; vectors as three components in any consistent unit
review.G-06: one constant (WGS-84 angular velocity); cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; stated that this is not a full ICRS-to-ITRS transformation and what it leaves out
